text.en: Believing a neutrino's flavour (electron, muon, tau) and its mass state are exactly the same thing, just different names for the same property — each flavour state is actually a quantum superposition of different mass states, which is precisely why the flavour composition can change (oscillate) as the neutrino propagates.
text.et: Arvamus, et neutriino maitse (elektron, müün, tau) ja selle massiolek on täpselt sama asi, lihtsalt erinevad nimed samale omadusele — iga maitseolek on tegelikult kvantsuperpositsioon erinevatest massiolekutest, mis on täpselt see, miks maitsekoostis saab neutriino levimisel muutuda (võnkuda).
